records.name: Workforce Solutions Rural Capital Area - Hays County Center
records.description_en: Free help finding a job, writing a resume, and getting job training. Staff can also connect you to child care help and other services.
records.eligibility_summary_en: Open to job seekers. This center serves people in Hays County.
records.how_to_apply: Visit the center or call to get started. You can also call the main line at (844) 344-2780.
records.notes: Address and phone confirmed on workforcesolutionsrca.com/locations (2026-09-26). Hours not listed; call ahead. Board serves 9 counties (also Williamson). Main phone 1-844-344-2780.
records.description_es: Ayuda gratis para buscar trabajo, hacer su currículum y recibir capacitación laboral. El personal también le puede conectar con ayuda para el cuidado de niños y otros servicios.
records.eligibility_summary_es: Abierto a personas que buscan trabajo. Esta oficina atiende a personas del condado de Hays.
records.how_to_apply_es: Visite la oficina o llame para empezar. También puede llamar a la línea principal al (844) 344-2780.

records.name: Child Care Services (Child Care Scholarships)
records.description_en: Helps pay for child care so parents can work, go to school, or train for a job.
records.eligibility_summary_en: For families who meet income limits and live in the board's counties. Each parent must work, go to school, or train at least 25 hours a week on average (50 combined hours for two-parent homes), or be looking for work.

eligibility_rules.residency_required: Resident of Bastrop, Blanco, Burnet, Caldwell, Fayette, Hays, Lee, Llano, or Williamson County

documents_needed: Proof of work, school, or training hours
Self-employed: up to 3 consecutive months of revenue and expense records
records.how_to_apply: Apply online through the Texas Child Care Connection portal. For help, call 1-877-223-0404 or email rcachildcareservices@ruralcapital.net.
records.cost: Free or reduced cost; a parent share of cost may apply
records.notes: Income limits effective Oct 1, 2025 are in a PDF linked from the source page. School time limits apply (e.g., 72 months for a bachelor's degree, 18 months for GED).
records.description_es: Ayuda a pagar el cuidado de niños para que los padres puedan trabajar, estudiar o capacitarse para un empleo.
records.eligibility_summary_es: Para familias que cumplen con los límites de ingresos y viven en los condados que atiende esta agencia. Cada padre o madre debe trabajar, estudiar o capacitarse un promedio de al menos 25 horas por semana (50 horas en total si son dos padres en el hogar), o estar buscando trabajo.
records.how_to_apply_es: Solicite en línea por el portal Texas Child Care Connection. Si necesita ayuda, llame al 1-877-223-0404 o escriba a rcachildcareservices@ruralcapital.net.

records.name: Adult Education (GED, ESL, Career Training)
records.organization: Community Action, Inc. of Central Texas
records.description_en: Free classes for adults, including GED prep in English and Spanish, English classes, computer skills, college prep, and career training. Classes are in person and online.
records.eligibility_summary_en: Adults 19 and older who are allowed to work in the U.S. Young people 16 to 18 who are not in school may qualify (16-year-olds need a court order).
documents_needed: One of: Texas driver's license or state ID (not expired, not limited-term) plus Social Security card; U.S. military ID plus Social Security card; U.S. birth certificate plus valid driver's license or state ID; U.S. passport; Employment Authorization Card; or Permanent Resident Card
records.how_to_apply: Register online at communityaction.com/registration, call (737) 331-0372, or email adulted@communityaction.com.
records.notes: Also serves Williamson and rural Travis County. Official site lists mailing ZIP 78667 for the main office.
records.description_es: Clases gratis para adultos: preparación para el GED en inglés y español, clases de inglés, computación, preparación para la universidad y capacitación para empleos. Hay clases en persona y en línea.
records.eligibility_summary_es: Adultos de 19 años o más con permiso para trabajar en EE. UU. Jóvenes de 16 a 18 años que no estén en la escuela pueden calificar (los de 16 años necesitan una orden de la corte).
records.how_to_apply_es: Inscríbase en línea en communityaction.com/registration, llame al (737) 331-0372 o escriba a adulted@communityaction.com.

records.name: Head Start and Early Head Start
records.organization: Community Action, Inc. of Central Texas
records.description_en: Free early learning and child care for young children from low-income families, plus health, nutrition, and family support.
records.eligibility_summary_en: For low-income families with children from birth to age 5, and pregnant women, in Hays and Caldwell counties.
documents_needed: 2025 family income proof (Form 1040, W-2s, or TANF/SNAP/SSI award letter)
Foster placement papers, if foster child
records.how_to_apply: Fill out the online application in English or Spanish, then upload documents from the link in your confirmation email. You can also call (512) 392-1161.
records.notes: 8 sites across Hays and Caldwell counties; applications accepted year-round for 2026-2027. Families experiencing homelessness should contact staff for help with documents. A Sept 2025 Hays CISD resource list gives the Head Start admin office as 722 South McKie Street, San Marcos, (512) 396-3395 ext. 229.
records.description_es: Educación temprana y cuidado de niños gratis para niños pequeños de familias de bajos ingresos, además de apoyo en salud, nutrición y ayuda para la familia.
records.eligibility_summary_es: Para familias de bajos ingresos con niños desde recién nacidos hasta 5 años, y para mujeres embarazadas, en los condados de Hays y Caldwell.
records.how_to_apply_es: Llene la solicitud en línea en inglés o español. Después, suba sus documentos con el enlace que le llega en el correo de confirmación. También puede llamar al (512) 392-1161.

records.name: Community Health Services Clinic
records.organization: Community Action, Inc. of Central Texas
records.description_en: Low-cost clinic offering birth control, checkups, pregnancy tests, STD testing and treatment, and primary care visits.
records.eligibility_summary_en: For low-income men and women in Hays and Caldwell counties. Primary care is for families with income from 20% to 200% of the federal poverty level.
records.how_to_apply: Call the clinic to make an appointment.
records.notes: Address (611 West MLK) and phone confirmed on communityaction.com homepage. Services and income range from a Hays CISD resource list revised Sept 2025. Community Action's health page lists family planning, breast cancer services, and Medicaid assistance, and says it is a Texas women's health program provider.
records.description_es: Clínica de bajo costo con métodos anticonceptivos, chequeos, pruebas de embarazo, pruebas y tratamiento de enfermedades de transmisión sexual, y consultas de atención primaria.
records.eligibility_summary_es: Para hombres y mujeres de bajos ingresos en los condados de Hays y Caldwell. La atención primaria es para familias con ingresos entre el 20% y el 200% del nivel federal de pobreza.
records.how_to_apply_es: Llame a la clínica para hacer una cita.

records.name: Comprehensive Energy Assistance Program (CEAP)
records.organization: Community Action, Inc. of Central Texas
records.description_en: Helps eligible households pay electric, propane, water, and natural gas bills. Also offers case management and budgeting help.
records.eligibility_summary_en: For income-eligible households in Hays, Caldwell, and Blanco counties.
records.how_to_apply: Call for your county: Hays (512) 392-1161 ext. 324 or 334; Caldwell (830) 875-3707 or (512) 398-4420; Wimberley and Blanco County (512) 392-1161 ext. 309.
records.notes: Community Action's homepage (communityaction.com) lists Utility Assistance (CEAP) and Rental Assistance. Extensions and phones from a Hays CISD list revised Sept 2025. Aid depends on funding.
records.description_es: Ayuda a los hogares que califican a pagar las cuentas de luz, gas propano, agua y gas natural. También ofrece manejo de casos y ayuda con el presupuesto.
records.eligibility_summary_es: Para hogares que cumplen con los límites de ingresos en los condados de Hays, Caldwell y Blanco.
records.how_to_apply_es: Llame según su condado: Hays (512) 392-1161 ext. 324 o 334; Caldwell (830) 875-3707 o (512) 398-4420; Wimberley y condado de Blanco (512) 392-1161 ext. 309.

records.name: Utility Assistance (CEAP) and Rental Assistance
records.description_en: Helps income-eligible households pay electric, gas, and propane bills. Also offers rental help, home weatherization, and Meals on Wheels.
records.eligibility_summary_en: For low-income households in the agency's service area. Call to confirm your county qualifies.
records.how_to_apply: Apply using the online form linked on ccaction.com or call the Giddings office at (979) 540-2980. You can also email info@ccaction.com.
records.notes: Address, phone, hours, and services confirmed on ccaction.com (2026-09-26). Official site says it serves 10 rural counties but does not list them; county list (Lee, Fayette, Bastrop) is from third-party listings and is not confirmed. Third-party listings give a CEAP line of (979) 540-2987. Assistance depends on funding.
records.description_es: Ayuda a los hogares que califican por ingresos a pagar las cuentas de luz, gas y gas propano. También ofrece ayuda con la renta, arreglos para ahorrar energía en el hogar y Meals on Wheels (comidas a domicilio).
records.eligibility_summary_es: Para hogares de bajos ingresos en el área que atiende la agencia. Llame para confirmar si su condado califica.
records.how_to_apply_es: Solicite con el formulario en línea que aparece en ccaction.com o llame a la oficina de Giddings al (979) 540-2980. También puede escribir a info@ccaction.com.

records.name: Hays County Indigent Health Care Program
records.description_en: Pays for doctor visits, tests, hospital care, emergency care, and prescriptions for very low-income Hays County adults who cannot get Medicaid.
records.eligibility_summary_en: Hays County residents age 18 and older with income under 21% of the federal poverty level who do not qualify for Medicaid. Resource limits apply.
records.how_to_apply: Call the Hays County Health Department at (512) 393-5520 to check if you qualify.
records.notes: 2026 income limit: $3,351.60 per year for one person ($279.30/month); $6,930 per year for a family of four. Coverage capped at $30,000 per program year; hospital stays up to 30 days.
records.description_es: Paga consultas médicas, exámenes, atención en el hospital, emergencias y medicinas para adultos del condado de Hays con ingresos muy bajos que no pueden recibir Medicaid.
records.eligibility_summary_es: Residentes del condado de Hays de 18 años o más, con ingresos menores al 21% del nivel federal de pobreza, que no califican para Medicaid. También hay límites de bienes.
records.how_to_apply_es: Llame al Departamento de Salud del Condado de Hays al (512) 393-5520 para saber si califica.

records.name: CommuniCare Kyle Campus
records.description_en: Community health center with care for kids, teens, women, adults, and seniors, plus dental and behavioral health.
records.eligibility_summary_en: Open to everyone. Uninsured patients with household income under 200% of the poverty guidelines may get a sliding fee discount.
documents_needed: For sliding fee: proof of identity, income, and residency
records.how_to_apply: Call (512) 268-8900 to make an appointment. To apply for the sliding fee discount, call the eligibility team at (210) 233-7076 or email mes.team@communicaresa.org.
records.cost: Sliding scale; accepts Medicaid, CHIP, Medicare, and private insurance
records.notes: Sliding fee details from communicaresa.org/become-a-patient. A Sept 2025 Hays CISD list says WIC and pharmacy are also at this site; not confirmed on CommuniCare's page.
records.description_es: Centro de salud comunitario con atención para niños, adolescentes, mujeres, adultos y personas mayores, además de dental y salud mental.
records.eligibility_summary_es: Abierto a todos. Los pacientes sin seguro con ingresos familiares menores al 200% de las guías de pobreza pueden recibir un descuento según sus ingresos.
records.how_to_apply_es: Llame al (512) 268-8900 para hacer una cita. Para pedir el descuento según sus ingresos, llame al equipo de elegibilidad al (210) 233-7076 o escriba a mes.team@communicaresa.org.

records.notes: No dental listed at this site; see Kyle campus.

records.name: Lone Star Circle of Care at Bastrop
records.description_en: Community health center offering family medicine, children's care, behavioral health, and video visits.
records.eligibility_summary_en: Open to everyone, with or without insurance.
records.how_to_apply: Call 1-877-800-5722 or use the online scheduling on the website.
records.cost: Accepts insurance; ask about financial help
records.notes: HRSA-funded federally qualified health center. Spanish-speaking providers vary. Sliding fee details were not stated on the location page; ask when calling.
records.description_es: Centro de salud comunitario con medicina familiar, atención para niños, salud mental y consultas por video.
records.eligibility_summary_es: Abierto a todos, con o sin seguro médico.
records.how_to_apply_es: Llame al 1-877-800-5722 o haga su cita en línea en el sitio web.

records.name: Bluebonnet Trails 24/7 Crisis Line
records.description_en: Free 24/7 phone line for a mental health or substance use crisis, answered by trained mental health staff who can assess and connect you to care.
records.eligibility_summary_en: Anyone in Bastrop, Burnet, Caldwell, Fayette, or Lee County (plus Gonzales, Guadalupe, and Williamson).
records.how_to_apply: Call 1-800-841-1255 any time. For non-crisis appointments call 1-844-309-6385.
records.hours: 24 hours a day, 7 days a week
records.notes: Mobile Crisis Outreach Team available 24/7 across all 8 counties. Bluebonnet Trails is the Local Mental Health Authority for these counties. Call 911 for emergencies; 988 is also available.
records.description_es: Línea telefónica gratis, abierta las 24 horas, los 7 días, para crisis de salud mental o de uso de sustancias. Le atiende personal capacitado que puede evaluar su situación y conectarle con ayuda.
records.eligibility_summary_es: Cualquier persona en los condados de Bastrop, Burnet, Caldwell, Fayette o Lee (y también Gonzales, Guadalupe y Williamson).
records.how_to_apply_es: Llame al 1-800-841-1255 a cualquier hora. Para citas que no son de crisis, llame al 1-844-309-6385.

records.name: Bluebonnet Trails - Bastrop Clinic
records.description_en: Local public mental health center. Offers mental health care, crisis services, autism and developmental disability services, early childhood intervention, justice-involved services, and peer and veteran services.
records.eligibility_summary_en: For children and adults in Bastrop County who need mental health, substance use, or developmental disability services.
records.how_to_apply: Call 1-844-309-6385 for appointments. In a crisis, call 1-800-841-1255 (24/7).
records.notes: Hours and fees not listed on bbtrails.org/locations; call ahead. The locations page does not list substance use or housing/employment services at this site (other clinics list them). Bastrop ISD school-based site: 1602 Hill St., Bastrop, (512) 772-4887 (per raw research; not re-checked).
records.description_es: Centro público local de salud mental. Ofrece atención de salud mental, servicios de crisis, servicios para autismo y discapacidades del desarrollo, intervención temprana para niños pequeños, servicios para personas con casos en la justicia, y apoyo entre pares y para veteranos.
records.eligibility_summary_es: Para niños y adultos del condado de Bastrop que necesitan servicios de salud mental, uso de sustancias o discapacidades del desarrollo.
records.how_to_apply_es: Llame al 1-844-309-6385 para hacer una cita. Si está en crisis, llame al 1-800-841-1255 (24 horas, 7 días).

records.notes: Address, phone, and services confirmed on bbtrails.org/locations (2026-09-26). Hours and fees not listed; call ahead.

records.name: Hill Country MHDD Crisis Hotline
records.organization: Hill Country Mental Health & Developmental Disabilities Centers
records.description_en: Free 24/7 crisis line for people having a mental health crisis. Staff can connect you to crisis care.
records.eligibility_summary_en: Anyone in Hays, Blanco, or Llano County (and other Hill Country counties).
records.how_to_apply: Call 1-877-466-0660 any time.
records.hours: 24 hours a day, 7 days a week
records.notes: Hill Country MHDD is the Local Mental Health Authority for Hays, Blanco, and Llano. Main office (830) 792-3300. Charity Care Policy: no one is denied services due to inability to pay; sliding fee scale for those who qualify. Call 911 for emergencies; 988 is also available.
records.description_es: Línea de crisis gratis, abierta las 24 horas, los 7 días, para personas en una crisis de salud mental. El personal le puede conectar con atención de crisis.
records.eligibility_summary_es: Cualquier persona en los condados de Hays, Blanco o Llano (y otros condados de la región Hill Country).
records.how_to_apply_es: Llame al 1-877-466-0660 a cualquier hora.

records.how_to_apply_es: Llame al (512) 392-8953. Si está en crisis, llame al 1-877-466-0660.

records.name: Free Civil Legal Help
records.description_en: Free lawyers for low-income people with civil problems like evictions, housing, divorce and custody, and public benefits or disability denials.
records.eligibility_summary_en: Low-income residents of TRLA's 68 counties, including Hays, Caldwell, Bastrop, Burnet, Blanco, and Llano.
records.how_to_apply: Call the intake line at (833) 329-8752, Monday-Friday 9am-5pm.
records.notes: County list and intake line confirmed on trla.org/offices (2026-09-26). Nearest listed office is Austin; the page does not say which office handles each county. Alternate intake (956) 996-8752. Does NOT serve Fayette or Lee (see Lone Star Legal Aid).
records.description_es: Abogados gratis para personas de bajos ingresos con problemas civiles, como desalojos, vivienda, divorcio y custodia, y negación de beneficios públicos o por discapacidad.
records.eligibility_summary_es: Residentes de bajos ingresos de los 68 condados que atiende TRLA, incluyendo Hays, Caldwell, Bastrop, Burnet, Blanco y Llano.
records.how_to_apply_es: Llame a la línea de admisión al (833) 329-8752, de lunes a viernes, de 9 a.m. a 5 p.m.

records.name: Free Civil Legal Help
records.description_en: Free civil legal help for low-income people with problems like housing, family, and public benefits.
records.eligibility_summary_en: Low-income residents of its service area, which includes Fayette and Lee counties.
records.how_to_apply: Call (800) 733-8394 or apply online.
records.notes: County assignment confirmed on Texas Legal Services Center's legal aid map. Toll-free phone and online application link from lonestarlegal.org. Main office is in Houston.
records.description_es: Ayuda legal civil gratis para personas de bajos ingresos con problemas de vivienda, familia y beneficios públicos.
records.eligibility_summary_es: Residentes de bajos ingresos del área que atiende, que incluye los condados de Fayette y Lee.
records.how_to_apply_es: Llame al (800) 733-8394 o solicite en línea.

records.name: Hays-Caldwell Women's Center
records.description_en: Free, private help for people facing family violence, dating violence, sexual assault, or child abuse. Offers a 24-hour hotline, emergency shelter, counseling, hospital support, and help finding resources.
records.eligibility_summary_en: Adults, youth, and children in Hays and Caldwell counties affected by abuse.
records.how_to_apply: Call the 24-hour hotline at (512) 396-4357 or 1-800-700-4292.
records.notes: Office line (512) 396-3404. Shelter location is confidential.
records.description_es: Ayuda gratis y confidencial para personas que sufren violencia familiar, violencia en el noviazgo, agresión sexual o abuso infantil. Ofrece línea de ayuda las 24 horas, refugio de emergencia, consejería, acompañamiento en el hospital y ayuda para encontrar recursos.
records.eligibility_summary_es: Adultos, jóvenes y niños de los condados de Hays y Caldwell afectados por el abuso.
records.how_to_apply_es: Llame a la línea de ayuda de 24 horas al (512) 396-4357 o al 1-800-700-4292.

records.name: Highland Lakes Family Crisis Center
records.description_en: Free help for survivors of domestic violence and sexual assault, including a 24/7 hotline, emergency shelter, counseling, and legal and court advocacy.
records.eligibility_summary_en: Survivors of family violence, dating violence, stalking, or sexual assault in Burnet, Blanco, Llano, and Lampasas counties.
records.how_to_apply: Call the 24-hour hotline at (830) 693-3656 (TTY (830) 201-4756).
records.notes: Also serves Lampasas County.
records.description_es: Ayuda gratis para sobrevivientes de violencia doméstica y agresión sexual. Incluye línea de ayuda las 24 horas, los 7 días, refugio de emergencia, consejería y apoyo legal y en la corte.
records.eligibility_summary_es: Sobrevivientes de violencia familiar, violencia en el noviazgo, acoso o agresión sexual en los condados de Burnet, Blanco, Llano y Lampasas.
records.how_to_apply_es: Llame a la línea de ayuda de 24 horas al (830) 693-3656 (TTY (830) 201-4756).

records.name: CARTS Rural Transit
records.description_en: Public bus and ride service in rural Central Texas. It can take you to doctor visits, work, and errands. Seniors, people with disabilities, and kids under 12 pay half price.
records.eligibility_summary_en: Open to the public in CARTS counties. Half fare for seniors 60+, people with disabilities, children under 12, and registered customers.
records.how_to_apply: Call the Reservations Center at (512) 478-7433 or 1-800-456-7433 (Monday-Friday 7:00am-4:30pm), or request a ride online. Rides are confirmed only after a reservationist calls you back; for next-day rides, you must call.
records.cost: $2 in town, $4 in county, $6 all-day multi-county; half price for eligible riders
records.notes: Fares confirmed on ridecarts.com/fares-passes; reservation info on ridecarts.com/contact/request-a-ride (2026-09-26). Fare questions: (512) 481-1011. Seniors 60+ ride free on Country Bus services. Service area is the non-urbanized parts of these counties.
records.description_es: Servicio público de autobús y transporte en las zonas rurales del centro de Texas. Le puede llevar a citas médicas, al trabajo y a hacer mandados. Las personas mayores, las personas con discapacidad y los niños menores de 12 años pagan la mitad.
records.eligibility_summary_es: Abierto al público en los condados que atiende CARTS. Pagan la mitad las personas de 60 años o más, las personas con discapacidad, los niños menores de 12 años y los clientes registrados.
records.how_to_apply_es: Llame al Centro de Reservaciones al (512) 478-7433 o al 1-800-456-7433 (lunes a viernes, de 7:00 a.m. a 4:30 p.m.), o pida un viaje en línea. Su viaje queda confirmado solo cuando le devuelve la llamada un agente de reservaciones. Para viajes del día siguiente, debe llamar.

records.name: Texas State Counseling & Assessment Clinic
records.description_en: Counseling clinic at Texas State University, listed by the City of San Marcos as a local mental health resource.
records.eligibility_summary_en: People in the San Marcos area; call to ask who can be seen.
records.notes: Only the name and phone number are confirmed (City of San Marcos Mental Health page, 2026-09-26). The university clinic page could not be reached; cost, eligibility, and address not confirmed.
records.description_es: Clínica de consejería de la Universidad Estatal de Texas (Texas State University). La Ciudad de San Marcos la incluye como un recurso local de salud mental.
records.eligibility_summary_es: Personas del área de San Marcos. Llame para preguntar a quién pueden atender.

records.name: Youth Counseling and Parenting Classes (FAYS)
records.description_en: Free counseling for youth ages 6 to 17 to help with family conflict and everyday struggles, plus free parenting classes (STEP) and truancy help.
records.eligibility_summary_en: Children ages 6 to 17 who live in or go to school in Hays County, and their families.

eligibility_rules.residency_required: Child lives in or attends school in Hays County

records.how_to_apply: Call (512) 754-0500 or fill out the online referral form on gsmyc.org. Appointments Monday-Friday, including after school and after work.
records.hours: Monday-Friday by appointment, including after-school and after-work times
records.notes: Services, eligibility, and cost confirmed on gsmyc.org/services (2026-09-26). Official mailing address is P.O. Box 1455, San Marcos, TX 78666; a Hays CISD list (Sept 2025) gives 1402 IH 35 North, San Marcos 78666 (not confirmed on official site). GSMYC also runs a 24-hour crisis hotline, 1-800-457-0797.
records.description_es: Consejería gratis para jóvenes de 6 a 17 años para ayudar con conflictos en la familia y problemas del día a día. También ofrece clases gratis para padres (STEP) y ayuda con faltas a la escuela.
records.eligibility_summary_es: Niños y jóvenes de 6 a 17 años que viven o estudian en el condado de Hays, y sus familias.
records.how_to_apply_es: Llame al (512) 754-0500 o llene el formulario de referencia en línea en gsmyc.org. Hay citas de lunes a viernes, incluso después de la escuela y del trabajo.
